verdict.rationale: Plaid docs confirm that Identity Verification integrates directly with Plaid Monitor to check users against watchlists and PEP lists as part of an 'end-to-end verification and KYC solution' (docs-10, docs-13), giving ops a single-vendor solution. However, this requires pairing two separate Plaid products (IDV + Monitor) rather than a single unified API call, and adverse-media screening is not explicitly mentioned alongside watchlist/PEP checks. Missing for 10: explicit adverse-media coverage, confirmation of a single unified API/session (vs. two integrated products), and independent/hands-on corroboration of the combined review surface.
